53099693_d31e3ea6.text: These CRF projection neurons have been shown to exert a GABAergic phenotype (Dabrowska et al., 2013)

53099693_eb3c9ac4.text: .We then applied immunohistochemistry (IHC) to assess co-expression of CRF with our DREADD virus in dlBNST neurons

53099693_aa80db1b.text: .A qualitative assessment of the co-expression suggests that most, if not all, of the AAV8-hSyn-DIO-hM4d-mCherry+ neurons also expressed CRF immunoreactivity, consistent with the observation that 98% of GABAergic neurons in the dlBNST entail a CRF phenotype (Nguyen et al., 2016)

53099693_f0c5c390.text: .A recent study found that while CRF+ neurons in the BNST co-express both glutamate and GABA, within the dlBNST, about 98% of CRF+ neurons are GABAergic (Nguyen et al., 2016).
